# Incident Report Template

```yaml
id: IR-XXX
title: <incident title>
type: incident-report
version: 1.0
status: active
owner: <on-call engineer>
created: YYYY-MM-DD

review_frequency: on-change
depends_on: [ESC-001]
implements: []
related_documents: []
supersedes: []
tags: [incident, <severity>]
```
